summary: Multiple explosions reported in Tehran's Pakdasht area with widespread shaking felt across eastern districts. Iranian border forces killed a 15-year-old boy in Sarvabad county during an unannounced shooting of a civilian vehicle. Lebanese military conducted drone strikes on Nabatieh al-Fawqa while IDF eliminated Hezbollah and Hamas terrorists in separate operations.
key_points: Explosions reported in Pakdasht area of Tehran with buildings shaking and smoke observed from Qiyamadist hill at approximately 9:30 AM (Source: @VahidOnline/76928)
Iranian border forces shot at civilian vehicle in Sarvabad county's Darki village, killing 15-year-old Sam Hassan and seriously wounding his father (Source: @VahidOnline/76912)
IDF killed Hezbollah terrorist operating near Al-Tahir ridge infrastructure in precision airstrike, also eliminating another suspect on vehicle (Source: @idf_telegram/24595)
IDF killed Hamas terrorist Yehiya Saeed Muhammad Hamadan in southern Gaza Strip who participated in October 7 massacre (Source: @idf_telegram/24591)
Lebanese military conducted drone strikes on Nabatieh al-Fawqa with 14 reconnaissance drones detected (Source: @redlinkleb/30860)
Trump administration gave Iran 24 hours to publicly commit to not attacking ships and keeping Hormuz open (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75460)
USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier sailing north in Gulf of Oman approximately 250 km from Iran coast (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4808)

sections.threat_assessment: The Tehran explosions and Iranian border shooting incidents indicate potential internal security instability. Lebanese drone strikes and IDF counter-terrorism operations suggest ongoing cross-border tensions. Trump's 24-hour ultimatum to Iran creates immediate escalation risk in maritime domains. UAE's alleged support role for US strikes adds regional diplomatic complexity.
sections.regional_response: Iraqi resistance groups publicly supporting Iran's stance following Khamenei funeral demonstrates regional solidarity. Lebanese military conducting both offensive drone operations and ordnance disposal shows active engagement. US naval positioning near Iran and stalled commercial vessels in Hormuz indicate heightened maritime tensions. Israeli domestic security concerns reflected in terror plotting arrests.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple explosion reports in Tehran require verification for operational impact assessment. Iranian border force incidents in Sarvabad county suggest continued internal security challenges. Lebanese military drone activity concentrated in Nabatieh al-Fawqa area with high detection rates. US-Iran diplomatic channels remain active despite public ultimatums and technical failure claims.
